card: Cue sheet for the owner listening pass: a scripted bout's audio, drops explained
deviations_from_card: Per critic: the CLI lives in packages/tools/src/audio-cuesheet.ts (not packages/game/scripts); no packages/game/package.json edit; root package.json gained `audio:cuesheet` (taken under the lock, committed in the same commit, lock released). Case 3 was rewritten per the critic: impact x3 + cast.fire x3 + hit x2 fill the 8 effects voices within each cue's concurrency, then 'perfect' (priority 0). The test checks that the stolen row is the oldest priority-2 row (the impact at t=0) and that its id equals the steal admit() returns for the same active set. Requests in cases 2 and 3 are 150 ms apart, not the card's same-t timing: same-t requests drop on cooldown first, and even 100 ms steps drift under float (0.5-0.4 < 0.1) and trip the 100 ms cooldown. The bout driver (boutCueSheet: createLab plus mage AI on both sides, forecast.json competence and cap) sits in the pure game module so case 7 can test determinism in vitest. The tools CLI only parses arguments, reads the manifest and prints. Routes come from audio.json through routeEvent/uncuedKinds; nothing is copied. Played cues use the real admit() and variation() with a seeded mulberry32.
notes: Seed 7 (water vs fire, a loss at 42.65 s): 353 cue requests, 172 played. Peak effects voices 8 of 8. Most drops are cast.fire/cast.water on concurrency (35/34) or priority (30/37), plus impact on priority (19). Silent event kinds: cast x238, interrupt x2, down x1. npm run gate exits 1 only on packages/tools/src/smoke/checks.test.ts > 'leaves no literal frame or texture budget in the suites migrated onto the kit'. That file is untracked in-flight work by sibling smoke-browser-suite A. On the first run its missing harness-contract.ts broke tsc; on the re-run, about a minute later, build and lint were green and 863/864 vitest passed. I did not touch it.
